title: {{NAME}} and the Rainbow Bridge to Dinosaur Land
moral: The best adventures happen when you are open to new friends.

pages.content: {{NAME}} stood at the edge of a magical forest. A white unicorn waited there. Tiny fairies danced around the unicorn's glowing horn. 'Come with us,' said the unicorn. 'We are going to Dinosaur Land.' A shining rainbow bridge stretched ahead into the misty mountains.

pages.content: {{NAME}} stepped onto the rainbow bridge. It was soft under foot. Colours swirled below. At the end of the bridge, a big friendly dinosaur stood waiting. He had green spots and kind eyes. {{NAME}} felt a little shy. The fairy flew to {{NAME}}'s ear. 'He loves new friends,' she whispered.
